instruction: Add a comparison table to the 'Main Results' section of the report using rl+il baseline model performance data from '~/Documents/awesome-desktop/expe-results.xlsx'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting rl+il baseline model performance from Excel and inserting as a table. The evaluator verifies that a table with rl+il data exists in the document. This variation maintains similar complexity to the original by checking for a different model's data in the same Excel file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies table is in 'Main Results' section by checking for both 'main' and 'result' keywords in section_before (metrics/docx.py:64)
Uses proper regex pattern r'\brl\s*\+\s*il\b' for exact 'rl+il' matching with flexible spacing/case, avoiding false positives (metrics/docx.py:81-82)
Validates table contains numeric performance data by checking for digit patterns (metrics/docx.py:98-99)
Enforces minimum 3 columns for meaningful comparison table structure (expected.min_columns=3)
Implements sound partial credit logic: 0.3 for rl+il found anywhere, 0.5 for Main Results section, 1.0 for all criteria met
Getter properly extracts table content with section context by tracking preceding headings (getters/docx.py:59-94)
Postconfig appropriately saves document with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure fresh state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Section detection keyword list (getters/docx.py:74) is broad - could potentially improve by being more selective or hierarchical to better identify major sections vs subsections
Consider adding validation for table headers/first row to verify column types (model name column + metric columns) for stronger semantic verification
